_comment_header: SpiderPlus (4192) DCF overrides. Source: FY2025/12 Tanshin (filed 2026-02-12), Q1 FY2026/12 (filed 2026-05), all figures JPY mn. Single segment (consolidated direct revenue forecast, NOT SOTP).
_comment_market: Market data fallback for when yfinance is unavailable. shares_outstanding = issued shares at 2025-12 FY-end. generate_dcf.py re-applies these over any yfinance value.
_price_note: 244円 = 2026-06-12 終値（出所: yfinance、ユーザー承認 2026-06-12）
company_name: スパイダープラス株式会社
_comment_historical: Consolidated actuals. FY2024 and FY2025 from Tanshin. Revenue / OP / COGS / SGA / NetIncome / OCF / DA / Capex.
_comment_base_year: Base year = FY2025 actual. COGS% 26.1, SGA% 74.2, OP margin -0.2%.
_comment_nwc: NWC base from Q1 FY2026 BS (2026-03-31). AR=accounts receivable 620, INV=work in process 26, AP=accrued/payables 211.
_comment_scenarios: HYBRID design: Base follows ARR-trend (low churn 0.9%/mo, ARPU +16.7%, logos +15% => durable ~20% tapering). Upside/Downside take WIDE spread (construction 2024-problem tailwind vs construction recession / ANDPAD competition). Management = company plan FY2026 +20.5% held flat. SGA% declines faster in higher-growth scenarios (SaaS operating leverage). COGS% roughly flat ~26%.
_comment_capex_da: DA% 3.3 and Capex% 3.8 of revenue (FY2025). Software-heavy SaaS: capex is mostly capitalized software dev. Asset-light, so PGM and EV/Sales are primary (Exit-Multiple secondary). revenue_pct method.
_comment_tax: Tax rate: pre/early-profit, statutory ~30%. Note large carryforward losses (capital reduction 2026-05-01 wiped deficit) => effective cash tax may be lower near-term, but 30% conservative for steady-state.
_comment_wacc: User inputs: risk_free 2.3%, ERP 6.0%, size_premium 4.0%. Beta 1.45 (SaaS growth, construction-linked but subscription-buffered; ADJUST if you prefer 1.3-1.6 range). Cost of equity = 2.3 + 1.45*6.0 + 4.0 = 15.0%.
_comment_debt: Net cash position. Interest-bearing debt ~796 (ST 500 + current portion 153 + long 143), cash 2,355 (Q1-end) => net cash ~1,559. de_ratio tiny; cost_of_debt minor. de_ratio set low to reflect near-zero leverage (NOT EDINET-derived to avoid the narrow-taxonomy trap).
_comment_terminal: Terminal growth 1.5% (Japan long-run). Exit multiple: for SaaS use EV/Sales-consistent; 15x EBITDA placeholder but Exit method is SECONDARY here.
_comment_v3: Primary multiple = EV/Sales (SaaS standard; PER/EV-EBITDA unstable at near-zero profit). ARR FY2025 = 6,000 mn (+20.2%), useful for EV/ARR cross-check.
investment_thesis: 1. Construction-vertical SaaS leader: SPIDER+ embedded in major general contractors, 1,800+ companies, monthly churn 0.9% (high switching cost / durable ARR)
2. Triple growth engine: contract logos +15%, ARPU +16.7%, contract IDs +10% simultaneously => structural (not cost-cut) path to profitability
3. Operating-leverage inflection: reached operating breakeven in Q1 FY2026 (+5 mn) after FY2025 (-11 mn); construction 2024-problem & labor shortage are structural tailwinds for digitization
key_risks: 1. Founder owns 52.9% (Kenji Ito) => thin float, liquidity/exit risk and overhang if founder sells; weak minority governance
2. ANDPAD (unlisted, well-funded construction SaaS leader) competition could cap pricing/share
3. Construction capex cyclicality and a few large-account concentration could break the smooth ARR ramp; FY2026 plan (+20.5%, OP 50mn) still early in ramp
